notes: Departments, finished: switch off the built-in fields a department doesn't use, keep item categories to one department, import and export one department at a time, and find every photo, invoice and signed handover in its department's folder. Clearer users: a role, then All departments or Only some, each Can change or Can only look. Access is now enforced on labels, invoices, scans and Lost & Found too. A cleaner Product Catalog, and maintenance only shows once you set it up.
